notes.body:
I think there are only 2 potentially contentious parts to this change:

- get_udp_conversation_data() became static and is removed from header file and debian/libwireshark0.symbols.   I can find no reference to it being used anywhere else. In @pquantin 's commit where this was added to debian/libwireshark0.symbols, it was referenced by epan/follow.c, but this file has since been reworked and doesn't need to poke around the internals of UDP conversations anymore.

- usb_set_addr() is made static and removed from usb.h  But it is called for any valid header in dissect_usb_common().  @desowin  - is this likely to be used in any private dissectors?

Hi Martin,

I think I added get_udp_conversation_data() to have parity with the get_tcp_conversation_data() function. This is the kind of functions that seems useful to plugins, thus I'm not sure we should remove it from our exported symbols.
I think it is unlikely that someone developed private dissectior that would use usb_set_addr().
I got into difficulties with my branch - will close this MR and open another.
